rule_notes.aria-required-parent: [2026-04-25] MarginTable header row uses role=row + role=columnheader on a div-grid layout (not a real <table>). Wrapping in role=grid breaks aria-required-children because the empty-state / loading slots use role=status. Proper fix is either to convert MarginTable to a semantic <table> or to drop the role=* attrs and rely on aria-sort buttons alone. Slated for a follow-up beyond PR-1 since the desktop MarginTable still ships.
